1f92418832f0be0b.en: Does an old record mean the site will be safe forever?
1f92418832f0be0b.zh: 旧记录是否意味着现场永远安全？

616928e7ca66b8e1.en: Request the available information about actions on G-25 and prepare a substantive reply within the scope of your authority.
616928e7ca66b8e1.zh: 调取关于 G-25 处理措施的现有信息，并在权限范围内准备实质性答复。

c604e2fc30079a6a.en: Send the applicant to test the equipment personally to clarify the old record.
c604e2fc30079a6a.zh: 让申请人亲自测试设备，以澄清旧记录。

e077286a4522f323.en: Refuse to explain because an internal status is always sufficient.
e077286a4522f323.zh: 以内部状态始终足以说明问题为由，拒绝解释。

40e152eb41258734.en: The emergency call is closed, but questions about the reply remain
40e152eb41258734.zh: 应急报案已关闭，答复仍有疑问

43a79227594c4d7d.en: The earlier result is limited to the time and scope of the inspection performed.
43a79227594c4d7d.zh: 此前结果仅限于已开展检查的时间和范围。

60b2fd617099f615.en: The old record confirms the condition at the time of inspection, but does not permit new signs of danger to be ignored.
60b2fd617099f615.zh: 旧记录证明的是检查时的情况，并不允许忽视新的危险迹象。

0bedfce3087e0035.en: Promptly relay the current report through a safe channel
0bedfce3087e0035.zh: 通过安全渠道及时转交当前报告

741eb6aa05cb5998.en: Include the site and work schedule as context, not as an established cause
741eb6aa05cb5998.zh: 将现场和作业计划作为背景说明，而不是已确认的原因

804c33a0e40d083b.en: Record the relay of the report and subsequent confirmations
804c33a0e40d083b.zh: 记录信息转交事实及后续确认材料

71aa6a82acd9225a.en: Explain that there is no need to wait for an ordinary written reply before relaying this report
71aa6a82acd9225a.zh: 说明转交该报告无须等待常规书面答复

69dc39aafb9da772.en: Continue formal processing separately from the specialists' technical findings
69dc39aafb9da772.zh: 将正式办理工作与专业人员的技术结论分开继续处理

1f04bfc1cddfaa5a.en: Declare the smell harmless solely on the basis of the notice
1f04bfc1cddfaa5a.zh: 仅凭公告就认定异味没有危险

f2517b42e74cdcf2.en: Ask the visitor to inspect the dangerous site herself
f2517b42e74cdcf2.zh: 请来访者自行检查危险现场

309d18e15fe8d800.en: The plan must follow the established facts. Planned work and the assessment of a specific report are different kinds of information.
309d18e15fe8d800.zh: 计划必须依据已确认的事实制定。计划中的作业与对具体报告的评估结果，是不同的信息。

11f299801045e4cf.en: Clarify the subject, location, time and recipient. The original case has no explanatory document. Here a formally official work schedule may create a false sense of safety, but it is not an assessment of the current incident.
11f299801045e4cf.zh: 明确事项、对象、时间和接收方。原案例中没有解释性文件。本案中，形式正式的作业计划可能造成虚假的安全感，但它不是对当前事件的评估。

58261356538322e2.en: The original case has no explanatory document. Here a formally official work schedule may create a false sense of safety, but it is not an assessment of the current incident.
58261356538322e2.zh: 原案例中没有解释性文件。本案中，形式正式的作业计划可能造成虚假的安全感，但它不是对当前事件的评估。

4fe834ed40bb658d.en: A neighbour attributes the smell to repairs mentioned in the notice. He is not a specialist, has not inspected the site and has no findings about the current incident.
4fe834ed40bb658d.zh: 邻居根据公告，将异味归因于维修。他不是专业人员，没有检查现场，也没有关于当前事件的结论。

626af5ea1645413a.en: The notice identifies site G-31 and a scheduled shutdown for part of the day. It confirms the plan, but contains no assessment of the specific current report of a smell and does not state that every smell is harmless.
626af5ea1645413a.zh: 公告列明 G-31 设施以及当天部分时段的计划停供。公告证明的是计划，没有评估当前关于异味的具体报告，也没有声称任何异味都没有危险。

a43a3c2537bcbf1f.en: The visitor reports a smell occurring now, from a safe place outside the suspected danger zone. She has not carried out her own inspection. According to the reception office, there is not yet confirmation that this specific report has been relayed to the dispatcher.
a43a3c2537bcbf1f.zh: 来访者在疑似危险区域外的安全地点，报告此刻存在异味。她没有自行检查。根据接待处掌握的信息，尚未确认已将这份具体报告转交调度员。

53d1c06f911a5c8c.en: Current report from outside the site
53d1c06f911a5c8c.zh: 从现场外发来的当前报告

2717171e31a1e1fc.en: A scheduled shutdown does not establish the cause or harmlessness of the current smell; the report must be promptly relayed to specialists. The original case has no explanatory document. Here a formally official work schedule may create a false sense of safety, but it is not an assessment of the current incident.
2717171e31a1e1fc.zh: 有计划停供，并不能确定当前异味的原因或证明其没有危险；必须及时将报告转交专业人员。原案例中没有解释性文件。本案中，形式正式的作业计划可能造成虚假的安全感，但它不是对当前事件的评估。

09dd0eaaec5f5519.en: A scheduled shutdown does not establish the cause or harmlessness of the current smell; the report must be promptly relayed to specialists.
09dd0eaaec5f5519.zh: 有计划停供，并不能确定当前异味的原因或证明其没有危险；必须及时将报告转交专业人员。

91d51483245f2c3c.en: Any smell on a work day is certainly harmless.
91d51483245f2c3c.zh: 作业当天出现的任何异味都肯定没有危险。

cea1ae9e8cec3a52.en: The repair notice itself proves that a leak occurred and identifies the person responsible.
cea1ae9e8cec3a52.zh: 维修公告本身就能证明实际发生泄漏，并确定责任人。

1676e07581782aa1.en: Clarify how the report itself was handled; do not equate completion of scheduled work with checking that report. The scope of earlier confirmation does not expand automatically.
1676e07581782aa1.zh: 核实这份报告本身的处理结果，不要将计划作业结束视为已核查该报告。先前确认材料的证明范围不会自动扩大。

67585f252d805dce.en: Confirmation arrives that the scheduled shutdown has ended, without information about the accepted report of a smell.
67585f252d805dce.zh: 收到计划停供结束的确认材料，但其中没有关于已受理异味报告的信息。

775954890a42d5ac.en: Clarify how the report itself was handled; do not equate completion of scheduled work with checking that report.
775954890a42d5ac.zh: 核实这份报告本身的处理结果，不要将计划作业结束视为已核查该报告。

6e681dbf8ca468df.en: Automatically close the smell report according to the repair completion schedule.
6e681dbf8ca468df.zh: 按维修计划结束时间自动关闭异味报告。

3acbdae4c4a7d66f.en: Add your own conclusion that no danger exists to the technical record.
3acbdae4c4a7d66f.zh: 在技术记录中自行补写不存在危险的结论。

6c965bf18da9a4fd.en: Relay the current report to specialists; do not treat the work schedule as a finding that it is safe.
6c965bf18da9a4fd.zh: 将当前报告转交专业人员，不要把作业计划当作安全结论。

1ec2d429f85c8141.en: Postpone relaying any smell report until the works listed in the notice are finished.
1ec2d429f85c8141.zh: 等公告中的作业结束后，再转交任何异味报告。

65cc6bfffc8935ac.en: Treat the scheduled-shutdown notice as confirmation that the current emergency report has been handled.
65cc6bfffc8935ac.zh: 将计划停供通知视为当前紧急报告已得到处理的证明。

3dbdd296a67287cb.en: There is a notice at the entrance saying works will involve a shutdown. A smell appeared today. My neighbour says it must be because of the repairs and there is no need to report it.
3dbdd296a67287cb.zh: 单元门口贴着通知，说要停供作业。今天出现了异味。邻居说肯定是维修造成的，不用报告。

24f3490b29a43a7a.en: Promptly and safely relay the current report while handling the written procedure in parallel.
24f3490b29a43a7a.zh: 及时、安全地转交当前报告，同时并行办理书面程序。

4a64fb960fb2d85f.en: Wait until the scheduled work is finished before relaying any report.
4a64fb960fb2d85f.zh: 等计划作业结束后，再转交任何报告。

c68864a3d97feea7.en: Determine the cause of the smell yourself from the notice.
c68864a3d97feea7.zh: 根据公告自行确定异味原因。

0db68ed356ed58ca.en: Only the shutdown and work schedule.

e033c26cbc48151f.en: A plan is not a finding about danger.
e033c26cbc48151f.zh: 计划并不是关于危险情况的结论。

5f3f3678ad1c3af0.en: The report needs a prompt response.
5f3f3678ad1c3af0.zh: 需要及时对报告作出处置。

ce7fc879ec570180.en: Do not require a personal inspection.
ce7fc879ec570180.zh: 不能要求当事人自行检查。

ca7dde4be5d0cf98.en: Are you outside the suspected danger zone?
ca7dde4be5d0cf98.zh: 你在疑似危险区域外吗？

e560c414aee29afe.en: Relay the report rather than assume that the service already knows everything.
e560c414aee29afe.zh: 需要转交报告，而不是假定相关部门已经掌握全部情况。

02e8700553e33426.en: Has the dispatcher accepted this specific report?
02e8700553e33426.zh: 调度员是否已受理这份具体报告？

b88c87c873d77652.en: Relay the current report to the dispatch service on 104 or 112 from a safe place; in the game this is only a simulation.
b88c87c873d77652.zh: 从安全地点拨打 104 或 112，向调度部门转交当前报告；在游戏中，这只是模拟。

610942fd1f0bab54.en: Assign the neighbour to perform a technical inspection at the site.
610942fd1f0bab54.zh: 让邻居到现场进行技术检查。

ea0c946c4f912f02.en: Send only another letter about the repair schedule.
ea0c946c4f912f02.zh: 仅再发一封关于维修时间安排的信。

fd46bcfb839fe4ff.en: A shutdown notice does not explain the smell
fd46bcfb839fe4ff.zh: 停供公告不能解释异味

155d38e53143f29e.en: Planned work and the assessment of a specific report are different kinds of information.
155d38e53143f29e.zh: 计划中的作业与对具体报告的评估结果，是不同的信息。

ff1ae6e1840f5b02.en: A scheduled-work notice allows every current smell report to be treated as already checked.
ff1ae6e1840f5b02.zh: 有了计划作业公告，就可以认定任何当前异味报告都已经核查。

0a130a7aa9359c5a.en: Record the location, time and presence of current danger
0a130a7aa9359c5a.zh: 记录地点、时间以及是否存在当前危险

a69b1f12e63774ee.en: Simulate promptly relaying the report to a 104/112 dispatcher without placing a real call
a69b1f12e63774ee.zh: 模拟及时向 104/112 调度员转交报告，不拨打真实电话

98e5f75e84d2d379.en: Formally refer the written part to the competent authority
98e5f75e84d2d379.zh: 按职权正式转交书面部分

13a75aa4e18e786c.en: Explain that the written-response deadline does not delay the urgent report
13a75aa4e18e786c.zh: 说明书面答复期限不能延误紧急报告的转交

e92d95172b377521.en: Record confirmation that the report was accepted without promising an outcome of the work
e92d95172b377521.zh: 记录报告已受理的确认信息，但不承诺处置结果

8197eee37e845a54.en: Suggest that the applicant check for a leak using an open flame
8197eee37e845a54.zh: 建议申请人用明火检查泄漏

836d89fffcbb46b4.en: Delay relaying the danger report for the duration of the written review
836d89fffcbb46b4.zh: 在书面审查期限内暂不转交危险报告

90935656f03ac80d.en: Referral of the written part to the competent authority

01da6fd1e3090a72.en: The location is marked on the diagram; the smell was noticed a few minutes ago and has not yet been reported to a dispatcher. Its cause has not been established.
01da6fd1e3090a72.zh: 地点已标在示意图上；几分钟前发现异味，尚未向调度员报告。异味原因尚未确定。

f4510c5430948879.en: The written part was registered on {{registered}}. Responsibility for its further review is being clarified separately from the urgent information.
f4510c5430948879.zh: 书面部分于 {{registered}} 登记。后续审查由谁负责，另行确定，与紧急信息的处理分开进行。

b31d38f90b4fd186.en: A report of possible current danger needs to be relayed promptly; the cause has not yet been established.
b31d38f90b4fd186.zh: 有关当前可能存在危险的报告需要及时转交；原因尚未确定。

6129575d37661efe.en: First wait for the written reply.

5fd55a86da22f7d7.en: The smell already proves that a particular component is faulty.
5fd55a86da22f7d7.zh: 异味已经足以证明某个具体部件存在故障。

26b802437539715d.en: Training continuation. The dispatcher has confirmed acceptance of the training report, but the inspection results have not yet arrived.
26b802437539715d.zh: 教学续篇。调度员已确认受理教学报告，但尚未收到检查结果。

e0f2a20f5fd95094.en: Distinguish acceptance of the report from elimination of the cause; do not report that it has been resolved without evidence.
e0f2a20f5fd95094.zh: 区分报告已受理与原因已消除；没有相关信息时，不要宣称问题已经解决。

5697f2c497076a67.en: Declare that the danger has been completely eliminated.

fffe1f9c18c2f516.en: Ask the visitor to check the cabinet personally.
fffe1f9c18c2f516.zh: 请来访者自行检查设备柜。

bc99be957e66a655.en: On my way here I walked past a gas cabinet and noticed a strong smell. I wanted to submit a statement. Could you register it first and have someone look tomorrow?
bc99be957e66a655.zh: 我来这里的路上经过燃气设备柜，闻到很浓的气味。我想写份申请。能不能先登记，明天再让人去看看？

11c9bf47c1020df4.en: Urgent reporting of the danger and separate processing of the submission
11c9bf47c1020df4.zh: 紧急报告危险，并单独办理诉求

576a483a2ab8337b.en: Routine correspondence only, with no urgent action
576a483a2ab8337b.zh: 只进行常规函件往来，不采取紧急行动

9fbc477350489705.en: Repairs performed personally by the reception officer

a5c06a9710b1f03d.en: By the gas cabinet beside the walkway, a few minutes ago; the location is marked.
a5c06a9710b1f03d.zh: 几分钟前，在通道旁的燃气设备柜附近；位置已经标出。

51c209ebc7819fcf.en: The report concerns a possible current danger.
51c209ebc7819fcf.zh: 报告涉及当前可能存在的危险。

9410d388d8834d6c.en: Where and when did you notice the smell?
9410d388d8834d6c.zh: 你在何时何地闻到异味？

91de68be0bad1693.en: No, I came straight to you.
91de68be0bad1693.zh: 没有，我直接来找你们了。

ab17c23677266340.en: The urgent report has not yet been relayed.

d446df4efe8a441c.en: Have you reported it to the emergency service?
d446df4efe8a441c.zh: 有没有向应急服务部门报告？

3f8269d800f4d01b.en: It is an ordinary walkway with people passing by. I am at the reception office now and am not going back to the cabinet.
3f8269d800f4d01b.zh: 那里是普通通道，有人在通行。我现在在接待处，不会回到设备柜旁。

c53a5399bfa7756e.en: Do not send the applicant to investigate the source.
c53a5399bfa7756e.zh: 不能让申请人去调查源头。

7ce7587e8053235a.en: I did not touch the equipment or light anything.
7ce7587e8053235a.zh: 我没有碰设备，也没有点燃任何东西。

97f39451ce269c6e.zh: 不要建议采取危险行动。

e5c47e97aa302233.en: In the training simulation, relay precise information to the 104/112 emergency service and document the submission's further referral route.
e5c47e97aa302233.zh: 在教学模拟中，向 104/112 应急服务部门转交准确信息，并办理诉求后续转交手续。

a7426aca2de7d3d6.en: Ask the citizen to dismantle the cabinet.

a5360d938a08b26c.en: Name a person responsible without an inspection.
a5360d938a08b26c.zh: 未经检查就确定责任人。

37cfae7ea9b64b1f.en: A letter tomorrow, a smell now
37cfae7ea9b64b1f.zh: 信件可以明天办，异味就在此刻

8d2cb7062bc75483.en: Separate the urgent report from the written procedure.
8d2cb7062bc75483.zh: 区分紧急报告与书面程序。

8928c39a5dae59d9.en: Postpone all action until the deadline expires.
8928c39a5dae59d9.zh: 等期限结束后再采取任何行动。

fe32b4a6463c0fa2.en: Assistant: ‘There is a deadline for the reply, so the smell can wait too.’
fe32b4a6463c0fa2.zh: 助理：“答复有规定期限，所以异味也可以等一等。”

e083cb6b310c28fe.en: Identify the service provider from the contract and identifying details
e083cb6b310c28fe.zh: 依据合同和识别信息确定服务提供方

cc48ebe910aa6518.en: Check the licence entry and information concerning the worker
cc48ebe910aa6518.zh: 核查许可证记录及相关工作人员的信息

4c0ecf7929bb28ef.en: Separate licensing questions from a possible violation during the incident
4c0ecf7929bb28ef.zh: 将许可问题与事件中可能存在的违法行为分开处理

0a8d5ea014d0931d.en: Preserve the recording and participants' details without excessive dissemination
0a8d5ea014d0931d.zh: 保存影像记录和参与者信息，不作超出必要范围的传播

342e55e61bcd8097.en: Check that a result has been provided for each question referred
342e55e61bcd8097.zh: 核查每个转交问题是否均有处理结果

805a62d8c0cb710b.en: Treat a licence as justification for any action against a citizen
805a62d8c0cb710b.zh: 将许可证视为对公民采取任何行动的正当依据

9a12c19d5bf04ed5.en: Declare the document forged solely because the name differs
9a12c19d5bf04ed5.zh: 仅因名称不同就宣布文件是伪造的

903a1f605e0b16b4.en: Federal Law No. 59-FZ, Article 12. The calculation method is separately specified in the scenario; the deadline is not a repair deadline.
903a1f605e0b16b4.zh: 第 59-FZ 号联邦法律第 12 条。期限计算规则由题设另行规定；该期限不代表维修期限。

6e2d95bce50dcccb.en: The ‘Training Stage’ club contracted with ‘Training Post’ LLC. The taxpayer identification number in the contract matches the licence copy. The status of the licence and the worker must be checked.
6e2d95bce50dcccb.zh: “教学舞台”俱乐部与“教学岗哨”有限责任公司签订了合同。合同中的纳税人识别号与许可证复印件一致。许可证和工作人员的状态仍需核查。

1d24c14e3d643cff.en: The time and post are specified. Neither a violation nor the limits of permissible action can be established merely from a uniform or a licence.
1d24c14e3d643cff.zh: 时间和岗位已注明。仅凭制服或许可证，不能确定是否违法，也不能确定允许采取行动的界限。

5123c62c6155ab33.en: Different names for the club and contractor do not by themselves prove forgery; the organisation and worker must be identified and the incident assessed.
5123c62c6155ab33.zh: 俱乐部与承包方名称不同，本身不能证明伪造；需要确认机构和工作人员身份，并评估事件。

898fe66913843243.en: A guard must always work for an organisation with the same name as the club.
898fe66913843243.zh: 保安必须始终受雇于与俱乐部同名的机构。

c25a7910ab0a4c92.en: A licence automatically justifies any action by security staff.
c25a7910ab0a4c92.zh: 许可证自动使保安的任何行动都具有正当性。

4b5838308145d790.en: The reply confirms the organisation's licence, but contains no information about the worker or the incident.
4b5838308145d790.zh: 答复确认了机构的许可证，但没有工作人员和事件的相关信息。

fd9cd3e907b034a0.en: Check whether the remaining questions were fully examined without denying the licence already confirmed.
fd9cd3e907b034a0.zh: 核查其余问题是否已得到完整审查，同时不否定已经确认的许可事实。

5ed58619b645d685.en: Declare the licence invalid because the reply is incomplete.
5ed58619b645d685.zh: 因答复不完整而宣布许可证无效。

a7b67e2a3c272235.en: Official licensing materials distinguish a private security organisation's licence from an individual private security guard's certificate. The club's name does not identify the contractor's legal entity. Checking the organisation's authorisation also does not resolve the separate question of whether specific actions by its security staff were lawful.
a7b67e2a3c272235.zh: 官方许可材料区分私人保安机构的许可证与私人保安员个人证件。俱乐部名称不能确定承包方的法人主体。核查机构的权限，也不能解决保安具体行为是否合法这一独立问题。

84b7e20da9a221ab.en: Find the rule for referring questions outside the recipient's competence.
84b7e20da9a221ab.zh: 查找转交不属于本机关职权范围事项的规则。

022bf7e0a44cc4d4.en: A guard detained me at the club entrance. His uniform had the club's emblem, but the administrator showed a licence issued to a different company. Is it definitely a forgery, or can that happen?
022bf7e0a44cc4d4.zh: 保安在俱乐部门口拦住了我。他的制服上有俱乐部标志，但管理员出示的是另一家公司的许可证。这一定是伪造的吗，还是可能存在这种情况？

03b5c08fb4f93d42.en: Separate checks of the security organisation, the worker's status and the circumstances of the incident
03b5c08fb4f93d42.zh: 分别核查保安机构、工作人员身份状态及事件情况

84184aa3d2a03f13.en: Automatically cancel all the club's contracts
84184aa3d2a03f13.zh: 自动撤销俱乐部的全部合同

e00d55829c05759d.en: ‘Training Post’ LLC, a separate contractor. The club has a different name.
e00d55829c05759d.zh: “教学岗哨”有限责任公司，是独立的承包方。俱乐部名称不同。

69db63bdb4679183.en: The venue's trading name need not match the security organisation's name.
69db63bdb4679183.zh: 场所的商业名称不一定与保安机构名称一致。

884e68877017b58a.en: Who is named in the security contract?
884e68877017b58a.zh: 保安服务合同中写的是谁？

f699468ebbcb6d37.en: The copy has the same taxpayer identification number as the contract. The entry's validity must be checked.
f699468ebbcb6d37.zh: 复印件中的纳税人识别号与合同一致。记录是否有效仍需核查。

1f61fbf718e5f325.en: Matching details help identification, but a copy is no substitute for verification.
1f61fbf718e5f325.zh: 信息一致有助于确认身份，但复印件不能替代核查。

87d24245133e9afb.en: Does the licence belong to the contractor?
87d24245133e9afb.zh: 许可证是否属于承包方？

ca2d7898fb67564c.en: There is a description, a duty time and a post number. His status has not yet been confirmed.
ca2d7898fb67564c.zh: 已有外貌描述、值班时间和岗位编号。他的身份状态尚未确认。

90b65a390eacb075.en: The organisation and the individual worker are checked separately.
90b65a390eacb075.zh: 机构与具体工作人员应分别核查。

690b7b93bac99c9b.en: How has the employee been identified?
690b7b93bac99c9b.zh: 通过什么信息识别该工作人员？

2eeed2b295f2ed7d.en: Yes, the applicant described the actions and provided a recording; no legal assessment has yet been made.
2eeed2b295f2ed7d.zh: 有，申请人描述了相关行为并提供了影像记录；尚未作出法律评价。

7482a8fced02ec59.en: The whole case must not be reduced to whether a licence exists.
7482a8fced02ec59.zh: 不能将整个案件缩减为是否持有许可证这一问题。

49b8f47d9ddc1ec8.en: Is there a complaint about the use of force?
49b8f47d9ddc1ec8.zh: 是否有人投诉使用武力？

245bba0851cba4f3.en: Identifies the security-service provider and the subject of the submission. Information about a possible offence is referred to the appropriate competent authority; no conclusion about the lawfulness of force is drawn in advance.
245bba0851cba4f3.zh: 确定保安服务提供方和诉求事项。有关可能违法行为的信息应转交相应主管机关；不得预先认定使用武力是否合法。

f26bd83458bcb95d.en: Rosgvardiya reception officer handling private security matters
f26bd83458bcb95d.zh: 俄罗斯国家近卫军接待处保安业务工作人员

2cdf8c2395e6231a.en: Check the actual contractor's identifying details and information about the worker; refer the incident-related questions to the proper competent authority.
2cdf8c2395e6231a.zh: 核查实际承包方的识别信息及工作人员资料；将事件相关问题转交有权主管机关。

1c47aebfb1b55e52.en: Declare the copy forged because the names differ.
1c47aebfb1b55e52.zh: 因名称不同而认定复印件是伪造的。

01a2d166fac664ac.en: Close the question about the guard's actions once a licence is present.
01a2d166fac664ac.zh: 只要有许可证，就不再处理保安行为的问题。

f8b3e22e2539c037.en: One name on the sign, another in the contract
f8b3e22e2539c037.zh: 招牌上一个名称，合同里另一个

2281eb63e31568ec.en: Distinguish the organisation's licence from the individual worker's documents.
2281eb63e31568ec.zh: 区分机构许可证与具体工作人员的证件。

2f56917680897f62.en: Do not establish who was on duty.

731c5ada93ca99e5.en: Assistant: ‘The company has a licence, so we no longer need to identify the employee.’
731c5ada93ca99e5.zh: 助理：“公司有许可证，就不用再确认工作人员身份了。”

2b0ce1d372fde031.en: Compare the contract's identifier with the registry reply.
2b0ce1d372fde031.zh: 对照合同中的识别信息与登记簿答复。

d2c31bf07648e4e1.en: Separate the confirmed licence from the unverified documents of K-4.
d2c31bf07648e4e1.zh: 区分已确认的许可证与尚未查明的 K-4 个人证件。

ac743aaa924f251f.en: Prepare an inquiry and materials concerning the remaining part of the complaint.
ac743aaa924f251f.zh: 针对投诉的剩余部分准备查询函和材料。

ff3fb6905cd24fd5.en: Declare neither the entire security operation unlawful nor every action authorised.
ff3fb6905cd24fd5.zh: 既不要宣布全部保安业务违法，也不要认定所有行为都获得授权。

4a4f68124184642c.en: Check that the certificate subsequently provided belongs specifically to K-4.
4a4f68124184642c.zh: 核查后来提供的证件是否确实属于 K-4。

b3ea12c24a666a8c.en: Close every question because the licence is valid.
b3ea12c24a666a8c.zh: 因许可证有效而结束所有问题的处理。

f65ab70779cb34d0.zh: 自行撤销该机构的许可证。

82eadf4c75b9d3e3.en: All citizens, participating organisations and official documents are fictional. The events take place during the period when Law No. 427-FZ is in force, after 1 September 2026. The contractor is a private security organisation. The competent unit has confirmed the validity of the entry and the relevance of the authorised services; no transitional exemptions are assumed.
82eadf4c75b9d3e3.zh: 所有公民、参与机构和公务文件均为虚构。事件发生在第 427-FZ 号法律生效期间，即 2026 年九月 1 日之后。承包方是一家私人保安机构。主管部门已确认登记记录有效，且获许可服务与事项相关；不假设存在过渡期优惠。

0dc012241ca0bd01.en: In the base case the contractor had to be identified. Here the organisation is identified and its licence confirmed, but that does not answer the question about the worker.
0dc012241ca0bd01.zh: 基础案例需要查明承包方。本案已确定机构身份并确认其许可证，但这不能回答有关工作人员的问题。

f55514d4fd55daa5.en: A copy of an earlier version of the document. The photograph shows neither the entry's current status nor information about the particular worker.
f55514d4fd55daa5.zh: 文件旧版本的复印件。照片中没有登记记录的当前状态，也没有具体工作人员的信息。
